purpose: High-fidelity UX concept review, illustrative data, not live game UI.

screens.name: 01-overview
screens.design_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE polished, production-plausible high-fidelity desktop GAME interface screenshot, landscape 16:9, 2560×1440, for the Chinese smart-grid simulation game 潮汐电网 / TIDAL GRID. This is a new UX concept, not a marketing poster and not a collage.
REFERENCE IMAGE 1 is the actual existing Godot gameplay: faithfully retain the modest, delightful isometric low-poly miniature bay, mint grass, teal ocean, toy-sized teal-roof facilities, roads, wind turbine, solar panels, substation, hospital and industry; do not replace it with a photorealistic metropolis. Redesign ALL interface overlays. Clean flat UI drawn over that real miniature setting. No 3D bevels on controls, no blue neon, no overwhelming decorative borders.
SHARED DESIGN SYSTEM: deep petrol #102b34 opaque surfaces, quieter secondary #193942, warm ivory #eeeae0 readable Chinese sans-serif, mint #7edbc0 primary action, amber warnings, coral power deficits. Crisp typography and 8px spacing rhythm, small restrained 8px radii, quiet dividers, ample whitespace, one dominant action. Labels 18–22px equivalent at 2560px. Numbers tabular and clearly larger. Flat line icons with text. Normal states quiet. Chinese text must be accurate and sharply legible.
SHARED SHELL: 76px high top status bar with small logo on left "潮汐电网", followed by power, cash, net income; clock and pause/speed at far right. Left 104px wide vertical navigation, compact icon-plus-text, entries "总览", "建设", "经营", "运维", "发展"; help and settings at bottom. Reserve the rest for map and a 350px right context drawer, no floating duplicate panels. Keep all controls fully inside frame. Bottom narrow status strip says "高保真概念稿 · 示例数据" in discreet small type.
SCREEN 01 — OPERATIONAL OVERVIEW, "总览" selected. Show a generous game map (roughly 65% of usable area) with the native miniature island. Only relevant map annotations: teal "中央变电站" and amber ring around "工业园区 · 未接网", an amber dashed proposed connection between the correct two endpoints. No grids all over the scene. Tiny top-left map header "青屿湾 / 第一期".
STATUS BAR: "供电 52%" with a compact horizontal supplied / gap bar, second line "11.9 / 22.9 MW"; coral "缺口 11.0 MW"; "资金 ¥180,000"; "净收益 +¥952/h"; "第1天 08:00"; pause, "1×", "3×", "8×" compact group.
At upper left inside map one restrained objective ribbon "当前目标  让工业园接入电网" and progress "1 / 5".
RIGHT drawer must have clear hierarchy top to bottom: small amber eyebrow "优先处理 · 1", prominent heading "工业园尚未接网", small status "公开拓扑 · 已确认", facility thumbnail. Then one SHORT explanation "已建设施尚未连接到电网。" A simple vertical three-step chain "选择中央变电站" → "连接工业园" → "确认建设". Show unambiguous next-step cost preview placeholder "连接前显示线路费用". Only ONE mint full-width primary button "开始接线" with secondary text link "查看供电详情". Lower drawer section separated by whitespace: "稍后关注", two quiet rows "储能容量   可查看" and "供需趋势   最近 6 小时" plus very small mini line graph with MW/time axes. Do not repeat the giant deficit inside drawer.
BOTTOM of map: compact anchored tools "选择 1", selected "接线 2", "抢修 3", "通信 4", "撤销选择 Esc"; one discreet contextual instruction "依次选择两个设施". Controls are substantial clickable-size, the scene remains dominant.
screens.refinement_prompt: Change ONLY TWO small Chinese labels. In the bottom-right chart section rename "供需趋势" to "已供电趋势" because there is just one supplied-power series; keep the graph itself. In the right drawer cost preview box change its small heading "线路费用（预估）" to "接线预览 · 待确认", keeping ¥8,000 and approximately0.4km unchanged. Preserve EVERY other label, number, map, logo, control, color, spacing and dimension exactly.

screens.name: 02-facility
screens.design_prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Render ONE full-screen high-fidelity desktop gameplay UI concept for the Chinese game "潮汐电网 / TIDAL GRID", landscape 16:9, approximately 2560×1440. This is a shippable-feeling interface screenshot, never a poster, never a collage. Reference image 1 is the approved-in-this-session redesigned OVERVIEW: match its logo, typography, spacing, top bar, left nav, flat surfaces and palette VERY CLOSELY across this family. Reference image 2 is the ACTUAL Godot miniature map: retain its simple low-poly toy architecture and teal/cream facilities whenever depicting map or buildings. Do not introduce photorealistic cities or elaborate unrealizable architecture.
Shared shell: top 76px dark status strip with "潮汐电网" logo, "供电 100%" compact 24.0 / 24.0 MW bar, "资金 ¥180,000", "净收益 +¥952/h", "第3天 09:20", pause and 1× 3× 8×. Left 104px compact nav "总览 / 建设 / 经营 / 运维 / 发展", help and settings below. Page title inside main area with a small "返回电网" link. Main reading flow is result → evidence → right-aligned decision drawer. No nested scrollbars. Deep petrol #102b34 opaque surfaces, secondary #193942, ivory #eeeae0 sharply readable Chinese sans-serif, mint #7edbc0 ONE primary action, amber concern, coral deficits. 8px rhythm, restrained 8px radii, quiet dividers, ample whitespace, accessible compact controls, numbers tabular. Avoid huge blocks of explanatory text. Tiny footer "高保真概念稿 · 示例数据 · 尚未接入仿真". No invented UI below frame. Chinese copy legible and verbatim.
SCREEN 02 — 设施调度 / selected left nav 建设. Header "设施与调度", local top tabs "设施目录" "运行方案" (selected) "参数对比". Narrow facility list below header left: search "搜索设施名称或编号", filter "全部 12", rows with tiny same-source isometric facility icons: 燃气电站 #01, 风力发电 #02, 光伏电站 #03, selected "储能电站 #09", 中央变电站 #04. Center evidence area: heading "储能电站 #09", small "可信遥测 · 09:20 更新"; large lovely miniature teal three-cabinet battery matching source map in a quiet illustrated scene, not photorealistic. Beside it TWO distinct units: "可用电量 18 / 30 MWh" using 60% energy tank, "额定功率 10 MW", "当前放电 6 MW"; "按当前出力可持续 3.0 h · 未计备用". Below, three same-axis horizontal power bars labeled "额定 10 MW", "可用 10 MW", "实际 6 MW", common axis 0 5 10 MW. Lower center a simple 6-hour "充放电记录" with zero baseline and positive discharge / negative charge, y-axis MW, x-axis 04:00 06:00 08:00 10:00, legend "放电 / 充电", no unverified predictions.
Right context drawer heading "运行方案", amber small "草案 · 尚未提交". A compact current-versus-draft comparison "当前生效：保供优先 · 备用 20%" / "本次草案：高峰支援 · 备用 30%". A select "运行目标  高峰支援", slider "有效备用电量 30%", time field "削峰起点 18:00". Execution method radio "现场队" selected showing "¥350 · 约21分钟", grey unavailable "远程下发" with reason "等待可信通信". ONE fixed-bottom mint primary "提交运行方案"; secondary "重置此设施草案". Very small status progression "草案 → 已排队 → 已生效", only 草案 active. Use sensible whitespace, never show applied checkmark before submission.
screens.refinement_prompt: Fix ONLY the following two numeric/time clarity details; preserve the rest of this screenshot exactly including all layout, Chinese text, buildings, colors, controls and other numbers. First change battery duration "3.0 h" to "2.8 h", and replace the adjacent note "未计备用" with "含放电损耗 · 未计备用" in appropriately small secondary type, fitting inside the existing field (wrap note if needed). Second correct the historical charge/discharge graph to stop BEFORE present time09:20: change last x-axis time "10:00" to "09:00"; at the last two historical bars around09:00 show mint positive discharge around +6MW above zero, matching current output6MW, and retain earlier mixed historical bars. Do not alter any other UI. No future bars after09:00.
